{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check sample_seq per patient to confirm re-testing
sample_seq_stats = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {len(sample_seq_stats[sample_seq_stats > 1])}')"}
